## LoginMapper interface

LoginMapper interface.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface LoginMapper extends Mapper<LoginDTO, LoginEntity> 
```
**Extends:** [Mapper](./foundation-auth.mapper.md)&lt;[LoginDTO](./foundation-auth.logindto.md), [LoginEntity](./foundation-auth.loginentity.md)&gt;

## Remarks

An extensible mapper for converting between login DTOs and Entities, where you can normalise data, implement derived fields, validation etc.

## Example

Overriding the default mapper for your application. Note the interface is the key.

```ts
import { DefaultLoginMapper, LoginMapper } from '@genesislcap/foundation-auth';
import { Container, Registration } from '@microsoft/fast-foundation';

class MyLoginMapper extends DefaultLoginMapper {
    // modify logic
}

@customElement({...})
export class MyApplication extends FASTElement {
    @Container container!: Container;
    connectedCallback() {
        this.container.register(Registration.singleton(LoginMapper, MyLoginMapper));
    }
}
```
